tips.title: Prioritize tools based on minimum diameter
tips.body: Tool D9.90 is retained when prioritizing by diameter.

tips.title: Prioritize tools based on shortest length
tips.body: Tool D10.1 is retained when prioritizing by tool length.

tips.title: Prioritize tools based on folder order
tips.body: Tools D2 and D3 are retained when prioritizing by folder order.

tips.title: Ensure at least one tool remains after prioritization
tips.body: At least one tool must remain even if several tools are available.

tips.title: Use user variables for tool search information exchange
tips.body: User variables can be used to transfer information between working steps.

tips.title: Set global user variables after macro transfer
tips.body: Global user variables are retained after macro transfer for information exchange.

tips.title: Change parameters in job configuration during macro transfer
tips.body: Parameters can be changed in one work step when transferring from a macro.

tips.title: Store search parameters if no tool is found
tips.body: Search parameters for the searched tool can be stored in the tool comment.

tips.title: Overwrite values in Feature Connector using Set connector
tips.body: Set connector can be used to overwrite values specified in the working step.

tips.title: Activate or deactivate drilling steps using Set connector
tips.body: Set connector can be used to activate or deactivate individual drilling steps.

tips.title: Create decision tables for tool search based on machine
tips.body: Decision tables can be used to define different criteria for searching tools.

tips.title: Define use cases in decision table for different machines
tips.body: Use cases can be defined to specify actions based on machine conditions.

tips.title: Call decision tables from Pre action, Search filter, and Post action
tips.body: Decision tables can be called from various stages of the tool search process.

tips.title: Modify and extend decision tables as needed
tips.body: Decision tables can be updated to include new machines or conditions.
